footprint_compatibility.profileRationale: The family has one authored public front and landmark silhouette. Mild rectangular drawing variation uses independent landmark scaling; larger targets repeat the stack along the long streetwall axis.

facade_sheet.goalpost_policy: The locked catalogue image controls silhouette, proportions, openings, roof hierarchy, entrance geometry and material hierarchy.

bay_strategy.rule: the landmark silhouette, entrance, corner returns, crown and roof stay fixed; only conservative fallback middle bands repeat

delivery.near_usage: close-range physical glazing and custom PBR construction

assembly_contract.side_elevations: front, left, right, rear and roof are authored as related but distinct construction; no elevation is a generic extrusion

elevation_coverage.front: primary public entrance, physical glazing and identity assembly
elevation_coverage.left: authored return with continued material and opening logic
elevation_coverage.right: authored return with continued material and opening logic
elevation_coverage.rear: quieter service elevation with compatible construction
elevation_coverage.roof: complete weathering plane, edge and screened service hierarchy

assembly_contract.variation_policy: the fixed landmark accepts mild independent X/Y scaling; larger or more distorted user targets use the conservative family stack

reference_registration.uv_strategy: render-locked facade bands and occupied-depth underlay cards behind physical glazing, plus reference-derived true-scale construction materials on authored physical envelopes

material_budget.rationale: Physical glazing, occupied depth, custom cladding, structure, roof and landscape remain separate so close-range materiality survives in every viewer.

architectural_identity: Fractured champagne-silver gallery towers frame a tall widening, inward-leaning low-iron atrium, with serrated parapets, deep cantilever notches and a carved triangular public entry.
material_zones: champagne-silver titanium panel rainscreen; charcoal structural steel; low-iron faceted atrium glass; warm timber public interiors; dark membrane roofs; pale concrete public plinth

source_provenance.reference_method: hard-reference multi-view completion followed by physical construction and custom PBR derivation
